text: The view of a probabilistic interactive oracle algorithm A is a function ViewA that maps the oracle f , the input z, the messages (ai )i∈[k] that the algorithm receives, and the randomness r to the tuple (z, r, (ai )i∈[k] , µ := ((qi , f (qi )))i∈[q] ), where (qi )i∈[q] is the list of all oracle queries of Af (z), Af (z, a1 ), . . . , and Af (z, a1 , . . . , ak ). For every oracle f , input z, messages (ai )i∈[k] and randomness r, the output of Af (z, (ai )i∈[k] ; r) is a function of ViewA (f, z, (ai )i∈[k] , r).
